note: Ottawa County KS publishes its county zoning (five districts: A-1, V-1, SR-1, B-1, I-1) through its planning and zoning pages, with no queryable ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable polygon service found. Searches of ArcGIS Hub and Online for Ottawa County Kansas zoning returned only Dickinson County's layers and unrelated datasets. The state KS ORKA portal shows ownership maps without zoning. Cities checked: Minneapolis KS code says the official zoning map is kept on file with the city clerk, so no city layer was found either.
